doc.title: Jimmy Heath interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, September 8, 2014

title: Tribute to Joe Wilder's trumpet sound and closing
summary: Rowe thanks Heath and asks about Joe Wilder, whom Heath recorded with; Heath praises his gorgeous sound, alongside Fats Navarro and Clifford Brown.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

Well I had him on a couple of my recordings. Joe Wilder had what I was talking about with Johnny Hodges and people like that. He had a gorgeous musical sound. The sound of music. That means a lot to me. And Joe Wilder had a sound that would touch you. He had a great trumpet sound. Fats Navarro was one. Clifford Brown. They had sounds. Yeah. All right. Thank you Mr. Heath.
